easyPrerequisites: Mardu Siegebreaker must be exiled by Lagrella, and Worldgorger Dragon must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Worldgorger Dragon for its mana cost.
When Worldgorger Dragon enters, it exiles Lagrella until Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Worldgorger Dragon's ETB.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Mardu Siegebreaker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it exiles Worldgorger Dragon until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Mardu Siegebreaker's ETB.
When Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield, Lagrella is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Lagrella enters, it exiles Mardu Siegebreaker until Lagrella leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lagrella's ETB.
When Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield, Worldgorger Dragon is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
